summary: Backend-only testing of IMAP IDLE (push-based) email sync. All 13 tests passed. IDLE watcher is running, connected to Gmail, and processing emails in near-realtime (~1-5s latency). Socket.IO broadcasting working correctly.

minor.issue: Intermittent 'Server replied with a response that violates the IMAP protocol' error during idle_check - occurs during server restarts, not normal operation
minor.note: IDLE watcher auto-reconnects with exponential backoff, system is resilient

critical_code_review_comments: IMAPIdleWatcher class correctly uses imapclient library (v3.1.0) for IDLE support
IDLE loop renews every 25 minutes before Gmail's ~29 min timeout
Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff (5s, 10s, 20s, 40s, max 60s) on failures
on_new_mail callback uses asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe for thread-safe event loop integration
UID tracking persists in imap_sync_state collection with seeded flag
Socket.IO broadcasts ticket:created and ticket:update events with properly serialized data
seed_data_creation: Created temporary test user/session for API testing, cleaned up after
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMAP IDLE push-based sync is fully working. State in MongoDB: imap_sync_state collection stores last_uid (currently 342) and seeded=true. GET /api/email/status returns mode='idle'. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_imap_idle.py can be reused for regression testing.

verified_features.backend_health: GET /api/health returns healthy with database check
verified_features.idle_watcher_running: Backend logs show '[IDLE] Connected and INBOX selected' - watcher is active
verified_features.email_status_mode: GET /api/email/status returns mode='idle' and connected=true with sync state
verified_features.manual_sync_endpoint: POST /api/email/sync works with UID tracking (fetch_all parameter supported)
verified_features.uid_state_persistence: imap_sync_state collection has last_uid=342, seeded=true, updated_at timestamp
verified_features.dedup_protection: Duplicate emails not re-processed via UID tracking and message_id checks
verified_features.socketio_broadcast: Socket.IO broadcasts ticket:created and ticket:update events (verified in logs)
